name: Domain Tracker
tagline: Watches the domains you hold and the ones you are still hoping to get
description: Two separate lists run side by side. Across the portfolio you already own it keeps tabs on renewal dates and whether mail and nameserver records still resolve correctly; on the wishlist it waits for a name to come free. Checks lean on public registry and lookup data unless you widen the remit.
author: Siddharth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
